import fcntl,gzip,hashlib,io,json,os,pathlib,stat,sys,zipfile
archive_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
original=archive_path.read_bytes()
assert len(original)==672184 and hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()=='6dff8fc354d9992ca7f19227d893a34c745f86da0d1cb642bd6ee144933fcbce'
candidates={}
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(original)) as z:
    for item in z.infolist():
        if item.is_dir() or item.file_size>64*1024*1024 or not item.filename.endswith('.gz'):continue
        raw=z.read(item)
        try:
            with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as stream:expanded=stream.read(256*1024*1024+1)
            if len(expanded)>256*1024*1024:continue
            data=json.loads(expanded)
        except (OSError,ValueError,UnicodeError):continue
        if data.get('schema')=='stellar-forge.coingecko-handover.v1' and data.get('payload',{}).get('project',{}).get('id')=='05c3eb83-9c7a-42a0-a683-4024e5f755b8':
            candidates[hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()]={'member':item.filename,'bytes':raw}
assert len(candidates)==1,'Inspect the original bundle manifest to resolve its project archive: '+repr([(k,v['member']) for k,v in candidates.items()])
sha,item=next(iter(candidates.items()));out.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
selected=out/'original-market-handover.json.gz'
def syncdir():
    fd=os.open(out,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:os.fsync(fd)
    finally:os.close(fd)
def exact(path,expected):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        first=os.fstat(fd);assert stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_size==len(expected),'Preserve the existing incomplete or conflicting final file: '+str(path)
        with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd),'rb') as stream:assert stream.read()==expected,'Preserve changed original bytes.'
        last=os.fstat(fd);named=path.lstat()
        assert (first.st_dev,first.st_ino,first.st_size,first.st_mtime_ns)==(last.st_dev,last.st_ino,last.st_size,last.st_mtime_ns)
        assert (first.st_dev,first.st_ino)==(named.st_dev,named.st_ino),'Original file identity changed.'
        return first
    finally:os.close(fd)
def publish(path,expected):
    digest=hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
    pending=out/('.'+path.name+'.'+digest+'.part')
    if path.exists() or path.is_symlink():
        final=exact(path,expected)
        if pending.exists() and not pending.is_symlink():
            interim=pending.lstat()
            if (interim.st_dev,interim.st_ino)==(final.st_dev,final.st_ino):
                pending.unlink();syncdir()
        return
    fd=os.open(pending,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
    try:
        initial=os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(initial.st_mode) and initial.st_nlink==1 and initial.st_size<=len(expected),'Preserve the existing staging identity.'
        with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd),'rb') as stream:
            prefix=stream.read()
        assert len(prefix)==initial.st_size and prefix==expected[:len(prefix)],'Preserve conflicting original staging bytes.'
        position=len(prefix);os.lseek(fd,position,os.SEEK_SET)
        while position<len(expected):
            count=os.write(fd,expected[position:position+1024*1024]);assert count>0
            position+=count
        os.fsync(fd)
        current=os.fstat(fd);named=pending.lstat()
        assert (initial.st_dev,initial.st_ino)==(current.st_dev,current.st_ino)==(named.st_dev,named.st_ino)
        assert current.st_size==len(expected)
        exact(pending,expected)
        try:os.link(pending,path)
        except FileExistsError:exact(path,expected)
        syncdir()
        assert (pending.lstat().st_dev,pending.lstat().st_ino)==(initial.st_dev,initial.st_ino)
        pending.unlink();syncdir()
    finally:os.close(fd)
lockfd=os.open(out/'original-archive-selection.lock',os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:
    lockstat=os.fstat(lockfd)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(lockstat.st_mode) and lockstat.st_nlink==1
    fcntl.flock(lockfd,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    claim={'schema':'commons.coingecko-original-archive-selection.v1',
           'operation':'COINGECKO-PRODUCT-DELIVERY-5403-20261012',
           'originalZipSha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),'member':item['member'],
           'projectId':'05c3eb83-9c7a-42a0-a683-4024e5f755b8',
           'archive':str(selected),'bytes':len(item['bytes']),'sha256':sha}
    publish(out/'original-archive-selection.json',(json.dumps(claim,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
    publish(selected,item['bytes'])
finally:os.close(lockfd)
print(json.dumps({'originalZip':str(archive_path),'member':item['member'],'archive':str(selected),'bytes':len(item['bytes']),'sha256':sha}))
